name: hashicorp-doc
description: HashiCorp-branded Word document skills. `hashicorp-doc-docx` builds a customer-facing .docx assessment or engagement report on the house template: full-bleed cover art with the wordmark, a metadata block, a live table of contents, a revision-history table, numbered sections under a `version / title` running header, rule-and-band recommendation tables carrying ID / Impact / Effort / Priority / Category, and the HashiCorp back cover. Editable Word, because the customer has to review and circulate it.
